description_nl: One codebase, two products (owner, 2026-09-18: 'the studio is tv + new features'). A server is told which it is by PORTAL_EDITION (a hosting fact, set in its service file). This chip says what each edition is called and which of the catalog's screens it shows; the framework's own admin screens are always there. tv is frozen - new screens are added to the studio only, except what the owner names for both (2026-09-20: frames 'Frames from a video' and images 'Image Library' on tv AND the studio; on tv the library has no Studio to send a picture to, so the page hides Use for a shot / character - the server says can_use). tour: the sign-in page's own tour video, served from static/tour (video, captions, poster). selling: the cards on the sign-in page, each [icon, title word, line word] (words are ui.app, with the edition's words_prefix). jump_signin: a Sign in button at the top of the sign-in page on a phone, where the form sits below the whole pitch. 2026-09-28: guideme (Guide Me Builder) on the studio only. 2026-09-28 owner ("make the door standard as the other sites"): doors - another address of the same edition (a second address of the studio) with its own name, line under the logo, first screen, pitch words (words_prefix) and cards; the same shell, sign-in card and menu, never a page of its own. read (Read stories) is the studio's shelf screen, a door's first screen. A door's screens: the ONLY portal screens its menu and search show (e.g. Watch, Read, Listen - no editing; Continue this story opens the studio). The framework's own admin screens stay for those who may open them. A door's launch: the Launch Studio button (top right) - for each of the door's hosts, the workshop address to open (a door's localhost opens the local studio). 2026-09-30 owner (Groups): groups - make a group of people by email, they accept, works are shared with it - on the studio (beside Publish & Circles) and on its door. site_hides (2026-10-01 owner: "keep the door's screens out of the main menu"): screens the edition's OWN address leaves off its menu and search because a door shows them (the door's screens live on its own address); they still open from a link or a bell. site_sends {this address: the door's address}: a link to a site_hides screen opened HERE is sent on to the door (2026-10-01 owner: "send door links to the door's address") - bookmarks and bells land on the door.
